ios.desc:
It's hard to know what to watch with all of the content available now. And it's difficult to keep track of whether what you want to watch is on your personal streaming services and when your favorite shows are returning. Use AddToTheList to help you find what's good to watch, what's new, what shows are returning, and where to watch anything!

Track all Movies and TV Shows that you watch with AddToTheList!
Find out what to watch based on what's popular on the top streaming services.
See what movies and shows are coming soon and are newly released.
See what's available to watch on your streaming services.
Track seasons/episodes of shows you love!
You can rate, write reviews and see where to watch any title.
Create Shared Lists and Search Parties with your friends.
Find out what to watch based on what your friends are watching.
Share what you love with other users by creating lists.
Add movies and shows to your lists to get notified when they come to your favorite streaming services.
Add your friends to easily chat with and recommend titles to each other.

Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Hey everyone! Just wanted to share a big update to the AddToTheList app/website I've been working on.

The biggest features are tracking seasons/episodes of shows you watch and Search Party.

Some of the newer features:

* Add season/episode tracking for shows.

* Watch Next queue has been added for episode tracking so you can easily log episodes as you watch them.

* Episodes can be rated, recommended, and messaged to friends.

* Per Episode views have been added to show more details about each episode as well as for easier tracking.

* Reviews can now be written for specific seasons or episodes.

* Search Party! You can now create a Search Party to find out what movie/show to watch in your group. Just start your search party, set your filters, share the link with your friends and start swiping! You can invite friends via the share link even if they are not users on AddToTheList.

* Add Stop Watching button for shows to remove it from the Watch Next queue and stop new episode notifications.

* Movie tracking is more uniform with show tracking now as well and you can see how many times you've watched a movie on the title view itself.

* You can now log movies and shows multiple times on the same day.

* Improved search.

* And much more including already present features like where to watch any movie/show, see what your friends are watching, see when titles are coming to/leaving streaming services, notifications for when your tracked titles come to your streaming services, …
